name: Quick Notes
description: A scratchpad on your desktop with note tabs you add, rename, reorder and delete (up to 12). Renders basic markdown as you type (headings, bold, lists), and right-click formats text: bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, highlight and eight text colours. Paste or drop pictures and drag their corner to size them. Saves as you type; everything stays on your PC.
author: AmineChr54
changelog: Right-click text to format it (bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, highlight, colours, headings, lists; also Ctrl+B/I/U). Paste or drop pictures and drag the corner to resize them. Tabs no longer widen when you hover them.
